main_text.l: XXVIII. EPISTOLA HENRICI REGIS AD AUGUSTUM Saxoniae Electorem.

CUm nos ab ineunte aetate puriorris doctrinae rudimentis imbuti succenderit mira quaedam & pene incredibilis cupiditas Principes eos invisendi, quorum opera Dominus ad propagandam nominis sui gloriam usus esset. Tum vero Illustrissimos illos Germaniae Proceres convenendos semper existimavimus; Princeps Illustrissime, apud quos primum veritas, veluti e densissimis tenebris quibus obscurata jam dudum fuit emersserat. Cujus defide-

page.notes: The initial C is a large woodcut letter, joined to "Um". Some words in the scan are damaged by print and show-through; "puriorris" and "emersserat" are printed as seen. The signature "H 2" and the catchword "rii" appear at the foot; the final word "defide-" runs on to the next page.
